question: How does even a single digit attain refuge in the matted locks belonging to Shankara?
premises: Even a single digit can transfer itself.
It approaches the matted hair mass.
It resorts to what belongs to Shankara.
inference: Even the smallest part can attain refuge in Shiva's domain by approaching his matted locks.
plain_english: Having transferred, even a single digit, having approached the matted hair mass, resorted to what belongs to Shankara.
